description: This file defines the 'testplan' class, which manages test plan operations within the TestLink project. It contains methods for creating, updating, copying, linking, unlinking test plans and related entities such as builds, milestones, test cases, keywords, platforms, and user roles. It also manages associated database interactions, audit logging, and supports complex copying and deletion logic for test plans and their linked components.

classes.name: testplan
classes.description: Class to coordinate and manage Test Plans within the TestLink project, handling creation, updates, copies, deletions, linking test cases, managing associated entities such as milestones, builds, user roles, keywords, platforms, as well as complex copy/deletion workflows involving multiple related database tables.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test plan node in the database under a specified test project, initializes related properties, and returns the new test plan ID.

methods.name: createFromObject
methods.description: Creates a new test plan using data from an object, performing necessary validations and inserting into the database.

methods.name: updateFromObject
methods.description: Updates an existing test plan's details based on provided object, with validation to avoid name duplicates.

methods.name: checkNameExistence
methods.description: Checks if a test plan with the given name already exists within a specific test project, excluding a given ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates core properties of an existing test plan such as name, notes, active, and public status.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a test plan record by its name, optionally filtered by test project.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a test plan by its ID with different output formats.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Returns all test plans in the system.

methods.name: count_testcases
methods.description: Counts the number of test cases linked to a test plan, optionally grouped by platform.

methods.name: tcversionInfoForAudit
methods.description: Retrieves info about test case versions linked to a test plan for audit purposes.

methods.name: link_tcversions
methods.description: Links test case versions to a test plan, rendering audit logs and managing references.

methods.name: setExecutionOrder
methods.description: Sets execution order for test case versions within a test plan.

methods.name: get_linked_items_id
methods.description: Retrieves the IDs of test cases linked to a test plan.

methods.name: get_linked_tcvid
methods.description: Fetches linked test case version IDs per platform, with optional additional info.

methods.name: getLinkedCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of linked test case versions within a test plan.

methods.name: getFeatureID
methods.description: Retrieves the internal feature ID linking test plan, platform, and test case version.

methods.name: getRootTestSuites
methods.description: Fetches the top-level test suites associated with a test plan.

methods.name: helper_keywords_sql
methods.description: Builds SQL snippets for filtering test cases related to specific keywords.

methods.name: helper_urgency_sql
methods.description: Generates SQL filter parts based on urgency importance levels.

methods.name: helper_assigned_to_sql
methods.description: Creates SQL parts for filtering test cases assigned to specific users or unassigned.

methods.name: helper_exec_status_filter
methods.description: Creates SQL filter parts for execution statuses, including handling 'not run' cases.

methods.name: helper_bugs_sql
methods.description: Builds SQL snippets for filtering based on bug IDs.

methods.name: get_linked_and_newest_tcversions
methods.description: Fetches the currently linked test case versions alongside the latest available versions for comparison.

methods.name: unlink_tcversions
methods.description: Removes linked test case versions from a test plan, cleaning related data and audit logs.

methods.name: get_keywords_map
methods.description: Retrieves a map of keywords associated with test cases in a test plan.

methods.name: DEPRECATED_get_keywords_tcases
methods.description: Deprecated method for fetching test cases with certain keywords linked to a test plan.

methods.name: getKeywordsLinkedTCVersions
methods.description: Gets keywords associated with test case versions linked to a test plan.

methods.name: getPlatformsLinkedTCVersions
methods.description: Retrieves linked platforms per test case version within a test plan.

methods.name: copy_as
methods.description: Creates a copy of a test plan, including options to duplicate linked entities and configurations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test plan and all its related data from multiple tables, including test cases, milestones, builds, and linked info.

methods.name: get_builds
methods.description: Retrieves all builds associated with a test plan.

methods.name: get_milestones
methods.description: Gets milestone information for a specific test plan.

methods.name: getUserRoleIDs
methods.description: Fetches all user roles assigned to a test plan.

methods.name: addUserRole
methods.description: Assigns a role to a user for a specific test plan.

methods.name: deleteUserRoles
methods.description: Removes all or specific user roles from a test plan.

methods.name: copy_builds
methods.description: Copies builds from one test plan to another, returning a mapping of old to new IDs.

methods.name: copy_linked_tcversions
methods.description: Copies linked test case versions and associated data from source to target plan, considering mappings and options.

methods.name: copy_milestones
methods.description: Copies milestones from one test plan to another.

methods.name: copy_user_roles
methods.description: Copies user roles from source test plan to target.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a test plan and all related data including test cases, milestones, builds, attachments, and hierarchical nodes, and logs the audit event.

methods.name: get_builds_for_html_options
methods.description: Retrieves builds linked to a test plan with optional filters for active and open status, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: get_max_build_id
methods.description: Returns the maximum build ID for a specific test plan, optionally filtered by active and open status.

methods.name: get_testsuites
methods.description: Fetches a list of all test suites associated with a test plan, including nested suites, sorted alphabetically.

methods.name: get_parenttestsuites
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all parent test suites of a given test suite node.

methods.name: compare_name
methods.description: Static method for sorting test suites alphabetically by name.

methods.name: get_builds
methods.description: Retrieves either a list of builds for a test plan or counts of builds, with filtering options and sorting.

methods.name: get_build_by_name
methods.description: Finds a build by name within a test plan, returning its details.

methods.name: get_build_by_id
methods.description: Returns details of a build using its ID within a test plan.

methods.name: getNumberOfBuilds
methods.description: Counts the number of builds associated with a test plan, with optional filters for active and open status.

methods.name: check_build_name_existence
methods.description: Checks if a build name already exists within a test plan, considering case sensitivity and optional build ID exclusion.

methods.name: get_build_id_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of a build given its name, ignoring case.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_design
methods.description: Gets custom fields linked to a test plan in design mode, filtered by Parent TestProject and show_on_execution flag.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_at_execution
methods.description: Gets custom fields linked to a test plan for execution, similar to design but during execution phase.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields_id
methods.description: Returns a map of custom field IDs to labels for a given test project, filtered to active and show on execution.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML table of custom field input elements for a given test plan, scope can be 'design' or 'execution'.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generates HTML table displaying custom field values for a test plan, with optional filters.

methods.name: filterByOnDesignCustomFields
methods.description: Filters a list of test cases based on specified custom field values, used during test specification creation.

methods.name: get_estimated_execution_time
methods.description: Calculates sum of the estimated execution durations from a specific custom field assigned to test cases in a test plan.

methods.name: getEstimatedExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the total estimated execution time from custom field data across linked test cases, per platform.

methods.name: getEstimatedExecutionTimeFromCF
methods.description: Calculates estimated execution time based on a specific custom field (e.g., CF_ESTIMATED_EXEC_TIME).

methods.name: get_execution_time
methods.description: Aggregates execution time from custom field CF_EXEC_TIME for test cases in a plan, optionally filtered by build or platform.

methods.name: getExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns total execution time from custom field values based on execution history, per platform.

methods.name: getExecutionTimeFromCF
methods.description: Calculates execution time using custom field CF_EXEC_TIME for linked test cases.

methods.name: get_prev_builds
methods.description: Retrieves previous builds before a specified build for a test plan, with optional active filter.

methods.name: get_same_status_for_build_set
methods.description: Finds test cases with identical execution status across a set of builds within a test plan on a given platform.

methods.name: get_not_run_for_any_build
methods.description: Finds test cases that have not been executed in any of a given set of builds within a test plan, on optional platform.

methods.name: copy_platforms_links
methods.description: Copies platform links from a source test plan to a target test plan, applying mappings if provided.

methods.name: copy_attachments
methods.description: Copies attachments from a source test plan to a target test plan.

methods.name: getPlatforms
methods.description: Retrieves linked platforms for a test plan, with options for output detail and format.

methods.name: hasLinkedPlatforms
methods.description: Checks if a test plan has associated active linked platforms.

methods.name: changeLinkedTCVersionsPlatform
methods.description: Updates platform ID for linked test case versions and associated execution records for a test plan.

methods.name: countLinkedTCVersionsByPlatform
methods.description: Returns count of linked test case versions grouped by platform within a test plan.

methods.name: getStatusForReports
methods.description: Provides mapping of status codes for reporting, including 'not_run'.

methods.name: getTestCaseSiblings
methods.description: Retrieves sibling test case versions within a test plan for a specific test case and platform, optionally filtered by user assignment.

methods.name: getTestCaseNextSibling
methods.description: Gets the next or previous sibling test case version relative to a given test case in a test plan.

methods.name: urgencyImportanceToPriorityLevel
methods.description: Converts urgency and importance ratings into a priority level (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW).

methods.name: exportLinkedItemsToXML
methods.description: Exports linked platforms and test cases of a test plan into an XML structure.

methods.name: exportTestPlanDataToXML
methods.description: Creates an XML document for a test plan including details, linked platforms, builds, and test cases, with options for filtering and context.

methods.name: exportDataToXML
methods.description: Serializes build or test plan data into XML format, including test suites, test cases, custom fields, and related elements, based on provided templates and mappings.

methods.name: exportTestSuiteDataToXML
methods.description: Exports hierarchical test suite and test case structures to XML, including linked keywords, custom fields, and test case details, supporting recursive tree navigation.

methods.name: getFeatureAssignments
methods.description: Retrieves feature-to-build assignments within a test plan, based on given filters, returning mappings of features to build IDs.

methods.name: getSkeleton
methods.description: Constructs a hierarchical representation (skeleton) of test suites and test cases for a test plan with applied filters; supports recursive traversal.

methods.name: _get_subtree_rec
methods.description: Recursively retrieves and filters nodes (test suites and test cases) to build parts of the test plan structure, applying filters and exclusions.

methods.name: getNotRunAllBuildsForPlatform
methods.description: Finds test cases that haven't been executed on all specified builds for a platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunAllBuildsForPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases not run on all builds within a platform set.

methods.name: getNotRunAtLeastOneBuildForPlatform
methods.description: Identifies test cases not executed in at least one build on a platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunAtLeastOneBuild
methods.description: Finds test cases that haven't been run in at least one build in a set.

methods.name: getNotRunOnBuildPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases not run on a specific build for a platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunOnBuildPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases not executed on a particular build for a platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunOnBuildALOP
methods.description: Retrieves test cases not run on a specific build for at least one platform (ALOP).

methods.name: getHitsNotRunPartialOnPlatform
methods.description: Fetches test cases not executed on at least one build for a platform, within a set.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetOnBuildPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases with specified statuses on a specific build and platform.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetOnBuildALOP
methods.description: Retrieves test cases with specified statuses on a specific build, across any platform (ALOP).

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetOnLatestExecALOP
methods.description: Gets test cases with at least one status in the set, based on the latest execution record across all builds (ALOP).

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetOnLatestExecOnPlatform
methods.description: Gets test cases with a specified status set on the latest execution for a platform.

methods.name: helperGetHitsSameStatusOnPlatform
methods.description: Internal helper to retrieve test cases with same or differing statuses on a platform, depending on mode (full or partial).

methods.name: getHitsSameStatusFullOnPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases with at least one requested status on all builds for a platform.

methods.name: getHitsSameStatusFullALOP
methods.description: Retrieves test cases with at least one status in the set on the latest execution across all builds (ALOP).

methods.name: getHitsSameStatusPartialOnPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves test cases with at least one status in the set on at least one build for a platform.

methods.name: getHitsSameStatusPartialALOP
methods.description: Retrieves test cases with at least one status in the set on at least one build across all platforms (ALOP).

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetPartialOnPlatform
methods.description: Fetches test cases with at least one status from set, based on last execution on any build for a platform.

methods.name: getHitsStatusSetPartialALOP
methods.description: Fetches test cases with at least one status in the set, based on last execution on any build, ignoring platform.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunPartialOnPlatform
methods.description: Finds test cases not run on at least one build for a platform within a set.

methods.name: getHitsNotRunPartialALOP
methods.description: Finds test cases not run on at least one build, ignoring platform, within a set.
